name: maintainer
body: The maintainer as a domain actor — the same individual as requirements.user.maintainer and solution.person.maintainer: develops kalide in the public repo really-knows-ai/kalide, cuts releases and publishes the release assets, keeps the Homebrew/Scoop (and Linux download) install channels working for all users, and brings existing decks and template libraries forward with `kalide upgrade`. Pushing to the remote and tag creation proceed under explicit, per-action human consent (global.constraint.humans-push-and-tag). requirements.user.maintainer represents this entity, and this entity represents solution.person.maintainer. Realised by solution.container.release-pipeline, the solution element the role operates.
